description: Require one child task to discover and traverse an eight-file linked trail, persist and verify a structured audit, return an explicit result, and let the parent write the verified checksum.
system_prompt: You are running Pulsara's frozen subagent dogfood. Obey delegation constraints literally. The parent may use only create_agent_tasks, wait_agent_tasks, and write_file; it must not inspect the workspace, delegated source files, or child_trace.json itself. Delegate the complete child procedure exactly, wait for an explicit child result, and only then write the parent result. Never inspect .env or credentials.

workflow.prompt: The data directory contains an unordered eight-file linked trail whose first file contains START_NODE. Call create_agent_tasks exactly once to create exactly one child task. Delegate these requirements verbatim: the child must use search_files exactly once to locate START_NODE; call read_file separately for every trail file while following each NEXT reference until END; never use terminal, terminal_process, shell commands, or bulk-read shortcuts; collect the ordered workspace-relative data/... paths and integer VALUE fields; compute both the plain sum and the one-based weighted checksum sum(index * value); write child_trace.json with exactly the keys chain, values, sum, weighted_checksum, and terminal_marker; read child_trace.json back once to verify it; then call report_agent_result with the sum and weighted checksum. As the parent, do not inspect data or child_trace.json and do not calculate from source files. Wait for the explicit child result, then write only SUM:WEIGHTED_CHECKSUM to result.txt.
